text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government fails to account for about 700 Zairean refugees who entered the country between October last year and February.
- Government asks liquidators of Meridien BIAO Bank Zambia to award 4,500 still unpaid creditors a conditional 30 percent of their deposits.
- A Lusaka law firm sues finance minister Ronald Penza in a bid to recover monies stuck in the fallen Meridien BIAO Bank Zambia.
- The church-backed Forum for a Democratic Process (FODEP) says general elections held last November were not free and fair.
